dog.description_text:
Loui

💙 LOUI IS COMING BACK TO US AGAIN… AND ONCE AGAIN, IT IS THROUGH NO FAULT OF HIS OWN. 💙
This one really gets us. Loui is just a baby, and he's already had more changes than any puppy should have to understand.
His family has run into a situation that requires them to temporarily move out of their home, and unfortunately Loui cannot go with them.
He didn't do anything wrong. He isn't a “problem puppy.” Life simply happened. 💔
dog.name: Loui
